# Kalari

> API migration verification for coding agents. MCP tools inspect changes and run consumers inside disposable microVMs.

## Read first

- [Judges walkthrough](/docs/judges/): A text guide to the published evidence.
- [Evidence and limits](/docs/evidence/): Benchmark scope, measurement basis, and limitations.
- [How Kalari learns](/docs/learn/): Observed runs, lessons, recall, and the observer path.
- [Installation](/docs/run-it-yourself/): Releases, configuration, and machine requirements.
- [MCP commands](/docs/mcp/): Setup and complete arguments for all tools.
- [Vultr deployment](/docs/vultr/): Hosting, inference, and operational commands.

## Read records directly

These public endpoints return JSON. They support GET and HEAD. Reads do not start a consumer or invoke a model.

- [Run IDs](/api/runs): Fetch each returned ID at /api/runs/ID.
- [Session IDs](/api/sessions): Fetch each returned ID at /api/sessions/ID.
- [Benchmark records](/api/benchmark): Each record carries its measurement payload.
- [Published lessons](/api/lessons): An empty list means no lesson records were returned.

Run details include evidence records with kind, session_id, run_id, and payload.
The interactive run viewer uses run.html?id=ID. The session viewer uses session.html?id=ID.

## Interpret the evidence

The frozen comparison and manufactured showcase are separate datasets.
The containment demonstration deliberately triggers a runaway cursor loop. It stays separate from benchmark totals.
A process can exit zero while verification fails. Read the checks and passed value alongside the process verdict.
Clef probabilities express a model's opinion. They are separate from measured outcomes.
The frozen comparison rows ran on an earlier build whose production validation refused the observer, so those rows carry no lessons and show no learned-memory benefit. Results from current version are being added.
The original benchmark and filming runs used earlier builds. New release fixes do not rewrite those rows.
